tools.name: get_instrument
tools.description: ONE named instrument, in full. Returns the Martingale Score (0-5), the current Startingale reading, the sector (with the industry for stocks), the score breakdown, the sequence structure (spacing, rounds, quantity multipliers) and exchange availability for a single crypto or US stock. Use this when

tools.name: search_instruments
tools.description: THE QUERY TOOL: find instruments matching criteria across an asset class. Filter by minimum Martingale score, minimum Startingale, exchange, sector and more; returns a ranked list. Use it when a filter OTHER than count, Startingale floor or sector is needed: exchange, round count, or a minimum Marti

tools.name: list_top_crypto
tools.description: A RANKED LIST OF CRYPTOS, sized by you: choose how many (1-20), an optional minimum Startingale and an optional sector. Use this when those are the ONLY conditions; anything else (a venue, a round count, a minimum Martingale Score) needs search_instruments. For a fixed top 5 with no arguments, use c

tools.name: list_top_stocks
tools.description: A RANKED LIST OF US STOCKS, sized by you: choose how many (1-20), an optional minimum Startingale and an optional sector. Use this when those are the ONLY conditions; anything else (a round count or a minimum Martingale Score) needs search_instruments. For a fixed top 5 with no arguments, use stock_

tools.name: market_overview
tools.description: ONE SNAPSHOT OF BOTH MARKETS, no arguments. Top instruments across crypto AND US stocks together, ranked by Martingale Score (0-5), with their Startingale readings. Use this to open a conversation or answer "how do things look right now". For a single asset class use crypto_overview or stock_overvie

tools.name: crypto_overview
tools.description: ONE SNAPSHOT OF CRYPTO ONLY, no arguments: the top 5 cryptos by Martingale Score (0-5) with their Startingale readings. Use this for a quick picture of crypto alone. To choose how many, apply a Startingale floor or keep one sector, use list_top_crypto; to cover stocks as well, use market_overview. A

tools.name: stock_overview
tools.description: ONE SNAPSHOT OF US STOCKS ONLY, no arguments: the top 5 stocks by Martingale Score (0-5) with their Startingale readings. Use this for a quick picture of stocks alone. To choose how many, apply a Startingale floor or keep one sector, use list_top_stocks; to cover crypto as well, use market_overview.
